comparison.objective: PR-2185 refits a mixer beater and guard, raises the bowl, and verifies powered start-stop operation; the candidate calibrates a gripper stop and verifies retained travel.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2185 tests slotted-hub alignment, push-turn retention, guard seating, lift operation, and controls; the candidate tests simultaneous driver/wrench countertorque on a screw and jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2185 requires retained assemblies, guarded five-second rotation, safe clearance, and stopped machinery; the candidate requires a 90° stop within tolerance after three cold cycles.
comparison.reason: Both include hands-off functional verification, but the adjusted-and-counterheld setting central to the candidate is absent from the mixer attachment task.
